description: Typed relations between STAGING spirit and artifact records. A relation grants neither endpoint canon status.

bonds.function: The reed can request one bounded route-reading from Sovaelin; it does not contain, summon, or command the spirit.
bonds.consent: Bearer and spirit restate destination, traveler count, and refusal conditions before every use.
bonds.price: The reed loses one harmonic route until the traveler records who bore the journey's externalized cost.
bonds.failure: Concealed passengers or military intent rotate every route reading toward the point of origin.
bonds.release: Either party ends contact by producing silence; no residual route authority remains.

bonds.function: Brannovar verifies seasonal reciprocity while the Seedmantle performs bounded Verdance cultivation.
bonds.consent: The local ecology, affected community, wearer, and Brannovar each hold an independent seasonal veto.
bonds.price: A quarter of every cultivated yield remains in the restoration commons until survival metrics pass.
bonds.failure: Monoculture pressure causes the mantle to germinate only uncultivated repair species.
bonds.release: At the seed audit the spirit may leave, the community may retire the mantle, or stewardship may transfer by unanimous renewed consent.

bonds.function: Mirevael supplies provenance and contradiction markers while the shell replays only consented memory layers.
bonds.consent: Every contributor controls audience, expiry, correction, and deletion; collective memory cannot overrule private scope.
bonds.price: Each replay attaches one unresolved responsibility that cannot be suppressed from the authorized audience.
bonds.failure: Attempted certainty or identity simulation turns the replay into water noise with visible missing-source markers.
bonds.release: Contributors can revoke their layer; when provenance falls below threshold, the shell retires the composite.

bonds.function: Cyrentha reveals the living purpose, bargaining asymmetry, and repair history behind an oath viewed through the lens.
bonds.consent: All living parties receive notice and a correction channel; coerced parties may block enforcement analysis.
bonds.price: The requesting institution undergoes the same breach analysis it requests for the oath.
bonds.failure: Literalist use overheats the lens and exposes every retired clause the operator tried to reactivate.
bonds.release: The spirit withdraws after repair, lawful retirement, or a finding that meaningful consent never existed.

bonds.function: Koravel witnesses who bears the mass displaced when the Orbitals alter load, access, or confinement.
bonds.consent: Affected occupants, infrastructure stewards, operator, and independent reviewer approve each nonemergency configuration.
bonds.price: Every shifted burden remains visible in the Orbitals until repaired rather than disappearing into accounting.
bonds.failure: Hidden externalities accumulate as asymmetric drag against the operator's own movement.
bonds.release: A public load audit clears the witness link and transfers unresolved obligations with the artifact.

bonds.function: The sail channels one of Aureth's bounded fronts only after evacuation, recovery, and succession conditions are staged.
bonds.consent: Crew, threatened settlement, recovery stewards, and Aureth must independently confirm the crisis boundary.
bonds.price: The invoked front closes until ecological and civic recovery for that activation is independently verified.
bonds.failure: Conquest intent grounds the storm into the vessel and makes every unplanned exit path visible to opponents.
bonds.release: Lowering the sail ends transmission immediately; the recovery obligation persists but no spirit presence remains trapped.

bonds.function: Lethirae distinguishes consensual silence from suppressed dissent before the bowl establishes a quiet field.
bonds.consent: Every participant receives a nonverbal exit signal and the collective cannot override one participant's refusal.
bonds.price: The bowl preserves one dissenting signal after each session so silence cannot rewrite the record.
bonds.failure: Coercive use causes the field to amplify the quietest refusal rather than suppress sound.
bonds.release: Any exit signal ends the field for that participant; the chorus leaves when the session record is returned.

bonds.function: The chorus supplies plural climate memory while the Vivarium coordinates long-horizon ecological affinity formation.
bonds.consent: Participants, affected communities, ecological stewards, and contributing chorus nodes renew consent every season.
bonds.price: Forecast benefits fund source communities and all permanent affinity candidates retain an unconditional withdrawal path.
bonds.failure: Single-model optimization causes the Vivarium to suspend affinity changes and expose excluded evidence.
bonds.release: Seasonal release separates every chorus node, returns data and correction rights, and restores participants to nondependent care.

bonds.function: Orunel asks which consequence the complete Luminor has excluded before the Assembly permits brief synthesis.
bonds.consent: This is a witness relation only; Orunel grants no power and may refuse contact without blocking lawful nonspirit operation.
bonds.price: The Luminor carries the named excluded consequence into the Assembly's existing imbalance and recovery cycle.
bonds.failure: Treating Orunel as an authorization authority closes the witness channel and records the attempted responsibility transfer.
bonds.release: The channel ends before synthesis begins; the Assembly never houses or binds the spirit.

bonds.function: The mask uses stolen Accord fragments to counterfeit bearer identity and execute obligations after refusal.
bonds.consent: No valid consent exists; both records remain quarantined as evidence and redesign tests.
bonds.price: Use erodes victims' revocation, context, and public identity while strengthening the counterfeit institution.
bonds.failure: Destroying the mask without restitution propagates active claims across every copied contract surface.
bonds.release: Nullify contracts, preserve evidence, return names, separate fragments, fund repair, and obtain independent consent before any recovered presence is classified.
